coreText_errorMessage.en: The service didn't return a recognizable result. Try again later; if you already submitted a funds action, check the latest status first.
coreText_errorMessage.zh: 服务没有返回可识别的结果。请稍后重试；如果已经提交过资金动作，请先查看最新状态。

coreText_errorMessage10.en: This page's data is out of date. Refresh before continuing.
coreText_errorMessage10.zh: 页面数据已不是最新，请刷新后再操作。

coreText_errorMessage11.en: The same action was already submitted with different content. Check the latest status, then try again.
coreText_errorMessage11.zh: 同一操作已被提交过且内容不同，请检查最新状态后再试。

coreText_errorMessage12.en: The indexer hasn't caught up with the latest block; data may lag. Try again later.
coreText_errorMessage12.zh: 索引尚未追上最新区块，数据可能滞后，稍后可以再试。

coreText_errorMessage13.en: Not enough available balance for this action (including fees).
coreText_errorMessage13.zh: 可用余额不足以完成此操作（含手续费）。

coreText_errorMessage14.en: Something went wrong and the result is unconfirmed. Check the latest status before deciding whether to retry.
coreText_errorMessage14.zh: 出了点问题，结果未确认。请查看最新状态后再决定是否重试。

coreText_errorMessage15.en: The request is malformed. Update the app or try again later.
coreText_errorMessage15.zh: 请求格式不正确，请更新 App 或稍后再试。

coreText_errorMessage16.en: A related service is under maintenance. Try again later.
coreText_errorMessage16.zh: 相关服务正在维护，稍后可以再试。

coreText_errorMessage17.en: The requested item doesn't exist or was removed.
coreText_errorMessage17.zh: 请求的对象不存在或已被移除。

coreText_errorMessage18.en: This account doesn't have permission for this action.
coreText_errorMessage18.zh: 当前账号无权执行此操作。

coreText_errorMessage19.en: This action was blocked by a policy in effect. The feature that started it explains the rule.
coreText_errorMessage19.zh: 此操作被当前生效的策略拦截。具体规则由发起该操作的功能说明。

coreText_errorMessage2.en: Finish setting up your LOOP account to continue.
coreText_errorMessage2.zh: 需要先完成 LOOP 账号引导才能继续。

coreText_errorMessage20.en: Community and social actions need an activated LOOP ID. Activate it, then try again.
coreText_errorMessage20.zh: 社区与社交操作需要已激活的 LOOP ID。完成激活后可以重试。

coreText_errorMessage21.en: A required external service isn't available right now. Try again later.
coreText_errorMessage21.zh: 所需的外部服务暂时不可用，稍后可以再试。

coreText_errorMessage22.en: The price changed. Refresh the quote before confirming.
coreText_errorMessage22.zh: 价格已变动，请刷新报价后再确认。

coreText_errorMessage23.en: Wait a moment and try again.

coreText_errorMessage24.en: This feature isn't available in your region.
coreText_errorMessage24.zh: 此功能在当前地区不可用。

coreText_errorMessage25.en: The service didn't respond in time. A timeout doesn't mean failure; for funds actions, check the latest status first.
coreText_errorMessage25.zh: 服务没有及时响应。超时不代表失败，资金动作请先查看最新状态。

coreText_errorMessage26.en: That ID already belongs to something else. Use another one.
coreText_errorMessage26.zh: 该标识已经属于另一个对象，请换一个再提交。

coreText_errorMessage27.en: The device session expired. Sign in again.
coreText_errorMessage27.zh: 设备会话已失效，请重新登录。

coreText_errorMessage28.en: The transaction simulation didn't return a verifiable result. Can't confirm right now.
coreText_errorMessage28.zh: 交易预演没有返回可验证结果，当前不能确认。

coreText_errorMessage29.en: The request may have been accepted. Don't submit again; wait for reconciliation.
coreText_errorMessage29.zh: 请求可能已被接受。请勿重复提交，等待对账结果。

coreText_errorMessage3.en: That name is on the current operator list. Try another.
coreText_errorMessage3.zh: 该名称在当前的运营名单内，请换一个再试。

coreText_errorMessage30.en: The input doesn't meet the requirements. Check it and try again.
coreText_errorMessage30.zh: 输入内容不符合要求，请检查后重试。

coreText_errorMessage31.en: The data was changed on another device. Reload before saving.
coreText_errorMessage31.zh: 数据已被其他设备修改，请重新加载后再保存。

coreText_errorMessage4.en: That name is reserved by LOOP (such as official, support, admin). Try another.
coreText_errorMessage4.zh: 该名称属于 LOOP 保留词（如官方、支持、管理），请换一个再试。

coreText_errorMessage5.en: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
coreText_errorMessage5.zh: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录。

coreText_errorMessage6.en: This action needs a signed-in account.
coreText_errorMessage6.zh: 此操作需要已登录的账号。

coreText_errorMessage7.en: You're signed in, but this action needs extra verification.
coreText_errorMessage7.zh: 当前登录有效，但此操作需要额外的身份验证。

coreText_errorMessage8.en: This feature isn't available right now. Try again later.
coreText_errorMessage8.zh: 这个功能暂时不可用，稍后再试。

coreText_errorMessage9.en: The requested network doesn't match the asset's or wallet's chain.
coreText_errorMessage9.zh: 请求的网络与资产或钱包所在链不一致。

coreText_tokenLoopTokenDescriptionError.en: Description can be up to {loopTokenDescriptionMaxCharacters} characters

coreText_tokenLoopTokenDescriptionError2.en: Description can't contain control or invisible characters
coreText_tokenLoopTokenDescriptionError2.zh: 简介不能包含控制符或不可见字符

coreText_tokenLoopTokenNameLengthMessage.en: Name can be up to 20 characters (emoji count as 2)
coreText_tokenLoopTokenNameLengthMessage.zh: 名称最多 20 个字（emoji 算 2 个字）

coreText_tokenLoopTokenTextRule.en: Name and ticker 1–20 characters each; Chinese, letters, numbers and emoji allowed
coreText_tokenLoopTokenTextRule.zh: 名称和代码各 1–20 个字，可用中文、字母、数字、emoji

coreText_tokenLoopTokenTickerLengthMessa.en: Ticker can be up to 20 characters (emoji count as 2)
coreText_tokenLoopTokenTickerLengthMessa.zh: 代码最多 20 个字（emoji 算 2 个字）

coreText_tokenTokenTextError2.en: {label} can't contain line breaks, control or invisible characters
coreText_tokenTokenTextError2.zh: {label}不能包含换行、控制符或不可见字符
